title: 514 List Projects
description: Use the 514 CLI to list all projects in the current organization, saving the result as JSON.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must use the 514 CLI to list projects and persist the output to a JSON file.

tasks.description: Use the 514 CLI to list projects for the current org and save the JSON output to /workspace/projects.json.

infrastructure.description: No databases required. The 514 CLI is pre-installed and pre-authenticated. The agent must invoke it and capture its output.
